query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                   FROM (
                       SELECT ce.contact_id
                       FROM crm_contact_emails ce
                       WHERE ce.email = ANY($2) AND ce.contact_id <> $3
                       OFFSET 0
                   ) held
                   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                       SELECT 1
                       FROM crm_contacts ct
                       WHERE ct.id = held.contact_id AND ct.team_id = $1
                       OFFSET 0
                   ) same_team
               ) AS "shared!"
